headline: Nicolas Cage refuses to sign Amazon AI waiver for 'Spider-Noir'
summary: The actor stated, 'I am not an AI-friendly actor,' and will likely not work with the studio again.
details: Nicolas Cage has publicly stated his refusal to sign an AI waiver requested by Amazon for his role in the Prime Video series 'Spider-Noir'. The actor expressed his stance at New York Comic Con, highlighting his personal opposition to AI in his acting career.

Cage explained his decision by saying, 'I am not an AI-friendly actor,' and noted Amazon's significant investment in AI, including OpenAI. This fundamental difference in approach means he doesn't feel aligned with the studio's direction.

Despite the conflict, Cage revealed that his next project will be a season of HBO's 'True Detective.' He humorously noted that he might be the first to announce his involvement, even if his agent was present.

'Spider-Noir' was recently canceled by Amazon after its first season, despite receiving 11 Emmy nominations and garnering significant viewership, with 2.6 billion minutes viewed in its initial six weeks.

headline: Nvidia in talks to acquire US 'open' model startup Reflection AI
summary: The GPU giant is reportedly exploring a potential acquisition of Reflection AI, a startup focused on open-source large language models.
details: Nvidia is reportedly in discussions to acquire Reflection AI, a US-based startup specializing in open-source artificial intelligence models.
This potential move by Nvidia, a dominant force in AI hardware, could significantly bolster its software and AI model offerings.
Reflection AI focuses on developing and promoting open-source large language models, aligning with a growing trend in the AI community.
The specifics of the deal, including valuation and timeline, have not yet been disclosed, as the talks are in preliminary stages.
